description:
Solarpro is part of Renalfa Solarpro Group GmbH, a Vienna-based clean energy and e-mobility investment group with a focus on renewable energy generation assets.


As a multi-technology integrator, Solarpro specializes in developing and delivering hybrid projects that combine photovoltaic (PV), wind, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and hydrogen solutions. With 17 years of experience and a team of more than 1,500 professionals, the company has designed, built, and integrated over 16 GW of solar capacity and more than 4 GWh of battery storage systems.


A recognized technology innovator, Solarpro leads in the design and digitalization of renewable energy projects, turning them into flexible and manageable assets that align with the dynamic energy market. The company’s expertise has been acknowledged internationally, winning the award for “Best EU Project under 100MW” for the first large-scale energy storage system in the region (55 MWh).


Driven by sustainability, Solarpro also invests in circular economy practices, advancing the recycling of PV modules and batteries to support the clean energy transition.


Our company is looking for a dedicated Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist / Engineer to ensure our solar projects meet the highest technical, safety, and durability standards throughout every phase of delivery. In this role, you will lead quality assurance activities across the entire project lifecycle.



Main responsibilities:

  • Develops necessary Internal and Project based Quality Documentation (Internal
    Quality Procedures, QMP, ITP, ICLT, NCRT).
  • Revises and updates already created Internal and Project based Quality Documentation.
  • Verifies and validates Quality related documentation emitted by other entities than Solarpro.
  • Updates all Quality related traceability and tracking documents used in the Project.
  • Perform Audits according to the planification or whenever necessary.
  • Submits all required documentation to his hierarchical manager or directly to the Client.
  • Communicates with Clients, Suppliers or other entities that are connected to the
  • Participate in the development, implementation and maintenance of the
    Quality, Safety, Health and Environment management system in the Company, in
    accordance with legal and other requirements applicable to the function.



Your profile:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Energy, Civil, or Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent technical field).
  • Experience: Minimum 2–3 years of QA/QC experience in industrial environment.  Experience in utility-scale PV plants, substations, or wind farms will represent an advantage.
  • Standards & Regulations: Familiarity with relevant quality standards (ISO 9001). Familiarity with Photovoltaic industry standards (e.g., IEC 62446, IEC 61215/61730) and applicable local building regulations will represent an advantage.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in reading different levels of complexity drawings and construction plans; Good understanding of Quality Management Systems; Proven experience with problem-solving methodologies; Strong prioritizing skills; Planning & organizing skills
  • Software: Proficient in MS Office (especially Excel); experience with punch-list or construction management software is a plus. 
  • Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (for equipment datasheets, international supplier coordination, and reporting).
  • Mobility: valid driver's license (Category B).


We offer:

  • Laptop, smartphone;
  • Health & Well-being: Comprehensive additional healthinsurance
  • Modern Environment, centrally located office
  • Long-Term Career Growth: Clear internal progression pathways into Senior Level Positions.
  • Work in a fast-growing sector with a key role in green energy;


Equal Opportunities

Solarpro provides equal employment opportunities to all candidates and employees. No discrimination is tolerated on the basis of ethnicity, religion, age, gender, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic. This applies to all stages of the recruitment process and employment relationship.


Data Processing and Confidentiality

Applications are processed confidentially by Solarpro solely for recruitment purposes. Personal data is not disclosed to third parties unless required by law. Providing personal data is voluntary. You may request access to, or correction of, your personal data by submitting a written request.
